summary: Yes, model family choice meaningfully affects predictive performance on the Adult Income dataset. The best model (Gradient Boosting, ROC-AUC=0.9216) outperforms the worst (SVM (RBF), ROC-AUC=0.7184) by 0.2033 ROC-AUC points.
methodological_choices: Preprocessing: Missing values imputed with median (numeric) or 'Unknown' (categorical). Features: 8 categorical features one-hot encoded, 6 numeric features standardized. Train/test split: 80/20 stratified. Models evaluated: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Decision Tree, SVM (RBF), KNN (k=5). Primary evaluation metric: ROC-AUC on held-out test set (n=9769). Cross-validation: 5-fold CV on training set for robustness check.
